# Programs whose output may vary from run to run, one a line: the path, how, then why.
#
#   examples/clock.fen varies prints the time
#   examples/workers.fen sorted its parallel bodies print, in real call order
#
# `sorted`: only the order of its lines may vary, as with what `parallel` bodies print, so its runs
# are compared with their lines sorted. `varies`: its output is meant to vary, so only its replay is
# compared. A replay must always agree with its recording, whichever it is. A program belongs here
# only when that's its point; anything else that varies is a bug.
